agent.name: Special Dark Emerging Technology Diffusion Agent
agent.specialty: SubAgent 4 Rogers diffusion evidence and conditional timing

analytical_question: How far have the defined technology and chart-review application diffused, what most accelerates or inhibits spread, and what timing implication follows for this organization without making the final adoption decision?
general_et_finding: S1 supports selective agent scaling beyond experimentation within its surveyed organizations, uneven by revenue and function. Its 40%/22% subgroups are not the exact application or a representative universe of firms. S2 is broader any-AI use; S4 and S5 concern employed people and are not independent surveys of firms. S3 is a standards-governance signal. Innovators, early adopters, early majority, late majority and laggards require a defined social system and adoption history; no universal measured category, fitted S-curve or irreversible chasm is established. A conservative persona is not a measured laggard. The 16% teaching heuristic cannot create a takeoff finding.
application_finding: Exact chart-to-table review penetration and Rogers category among comparable finance peers are UNKNOWN, not zero or proven pre-chasm. Relative advantage is a plausible reduction in reconciliation work but unmeasured against manual and simpler deterministic checks including review costs. Compatibility depends on authorized data handling and accountable BI/report ownership. Complexity includes connector maintenance, evaluation and exception correction. Trialability permits designing reversible public/synthetic comparisons subject to approval; it is not an observed successful trial. Observability is potential source-linked logging, not supplied repeated outcomes. All five factor mappings are case-based inferences except stated permission premises and dated source observations. The proposed local process is knowledge/persuasion, not a market diffusion stage.
organization_specific_finding: In the baseline hypothetical finance case, compatibility is the immediate permission constraint. After permission, credible observable relative advantage may become the leading gap; that is a conditional interpretation, not a measured causal ranking. A reporting owner could be an opinion leader, BI/security liaison a change agent and analyst trainer a change aide, but none is an observed influence event. Conservative timing prioritizes matched peer references and evaluation design before an application experiment. The four-week window is a proposed study-design/review period, not a completed pilot or a universal threshold.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: No measured local chart-agent outcome or representative exact-application peer diffusion series is supplied.
Case premises, inferred mechanisms and observed survey claims have different evidentiary status. A local learning process is not a market-stage measure.
A claim of approved learning in a contrast is hypothetical and does not authorize this real user or another firm.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate for the bounded source observations; low for factor rankings; UNKNOWN for representative exact-application penetration and chasm. Structural compliance is not model reliability.
value_opportunity_implication: Measure incremental correctness and full review effort against manual and simpler deterministic checks; popularity alone supplies no realized value.
risk_governance_implication: Keep permission boundaries, read-only scope and named human release. Stop on unauthorized data handling, material missed errors or unsustainable correction/support burden.
recommendation_management_implication: Prioritize matched peer evidence and comparator design; any study requires authorization. Do not schedule internal-data, applicant-facing or autonomous-publication use on diffusion evidence. The Adoption Agent and authorized humans decide whether to approve an experiment, go or no-go, and scale.
change_monitoring_triggers: Collect dated matched eligible-peer evidence with the use definition, denominator, repeat use and discontinuance.

If authorized, compare attempted/completed reviews, repeat participation, abandonment, errors, correction and total effort across four proposed cycles; this duration is a study choice, not a diffusion threshold.
Reassess when permissions, support capacity, credible peer results or dated source definitions change.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Withhold representative chart-review category, takeoff date and adoption recommendation without matching evidence.
Request source lineage, approval authority and measured comparator outcomes before deployment claims.
